<function name="SHA1" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
		Generates the [SHA-1 hash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-1) of the specified string.
		<warning>SHA-1 is considered cryptographically broken and is known to be vulnerable to a variety of attacks. If security is a concern, use <page>util.SHA256</page>.</warning>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2021.07.01</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="stringToHash" type="string">The string to calculate the SHA-1 hash of.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The SHA-1 hash of the string in hexadecimal form.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
